opportunities.title: Rescue and agent-proof the front door: one live site, tap-to-call, and intake agents for staffing requests and candidate submissions
opportunities.problem: Every route into the business is broken or human-only. The domain returns Cloudflare 502 on every URL (re-verified on 2026-11-13 while writing this), yet the Google Business Profile still sends searchers and AI assistants to it. Even when the site was up, the phone and email on the contact page were plain '<a href="#">' links (no tel:/mailto:), the repeating 'Let's Start!' CTA button and the whole careers list were commented out of the HTML, the newsletter form posted to action='#', and every page carried the template's default meta description 'Free Web tutorials'. Net effect: no click-to-call, no working quote/role intake, and nothing an AI assistant can read or act on.
evidence: https://www.adwaytech.com/ returns HTTP 502 at desktop and 390px width on 2026-11-13, and returned 502 again on a fresh fetch during this analysis (https://www.adwaytech.com/)
Browser review scores agent readiness as findable 1, answerable 0, bookable 0, because no URL returns readable text, schema or hours copy (https://www.adwaytech.com/)

The Google Maps listing for 'Adway Services INC' still lists website adwaytech.com and phone (609) 554-1888, so the listing's main button leads to the error page (https://www.google.com/maps/search/Adway+Services+77+Milltown+Rd+East+Brunswick+NJ)

Archived contact page: address, phone and fax are all '#' anchors, so neither a visitor nor an agent can tap to call or email (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)

Archived pages carry the template default meta description 'Free Web tutorials' and keywords 'HTML,CSS,XML,JavaScript', so search snippets and AI answers have no business-specific description (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

The site's most prominent CTA band ('Want to start a new project with us?') has its 'Contact Us' button commented out of the HTML (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916123941/https://adwaytech.com/products)
Login/Signup links point at /login/ and /register/ on the same dead origin, so the self-service portal is unreachable (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916134320/https://adwaytech.com/it-staffing)
opportunities.agent_design: Two-layer fix. (1) Front door: restore the origin or redeploy a static site on the existing domain and DNS, with real tel: and mailto: links, per-service pages (IT staffing, ERP, business consulting, training, the three products), LocalBusiness/ProfessionalService JSON-LD (address, hours, phone, service area), an accessible phone-width layout, an llms.txt/plain-text service summary, and a rebuilt Google Business Profile (category, services, photos, hours, correct site link). (2) On top of it, two event-driven intake agents with a shared queue: a client staffing-request agent that asks for role, tech stack, worksite location, duration, start date, rate band and interview process, then writes a structured requisition brief; and a candidate agent that acknowledges a resume upload in minutes, extracts skills, certifications, work-authorization type and location, and files it against open requisitions. Triggers are form submit, resume email to the intake address, or a call-back request. Both agents draft replies; a named recruiter/manager approves anything that goes back to a client or contains a rate quote. Every inbound is logged with source so the owner can finally see how inquiries are arriving.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: The origin is down and hosting has been cPanel-style shared hosting, so this needs DNS/hosting and TLS work, not a template tweak. A website builder or off-the-shelf chat widget cannot help: there is no live page for it to sit on, and the intake has to be machine-readable (schema, tel:, real form endpoints) and then hand structured requisitions and parsed resumes to a person, with spam control, audit logging and a queue that survives the 502 rather than posting to a naked /contact_mail/ endpoint. The candidate side also touches work-authorization data, which a consumer chatbot will happily mishandle.

impact_estimate.range: Customer-visible today: 100% of site visitors and AI assistants get an error page (0 of 3 agent-readiness checks pass). No sourced benchmark exists for recovered-inquiry revenue, so none is quoted. Direct cost of the fix: roughly 30-60 hours of build work = about $1.4k-$2.8k in labor at the NJ web-developer median.
impact_estimate.assumptions: Labor at the NJ median web-developer wage of $95,180/yr (about $45.76/hr) x 30-60 hours for hosting recovery, a static site, schema, forms and two intake agents; excludes hosting, domain and any Google profile verification effort. Revenue impact stated qualitatively only - an unsourced 'recovered inquiries' dollar figure would be invention.

opportunities.pilot_scope: 2-3 weeks: domain serving HTTP 200 on the same URLs; 5-6 pages of plain, readable service copy; working tel:/mailto: and two intake forms; a client staffing-request agent and a candidate-submission agent acknowledging within minutes into one queue; JSON-LD verified by a structured-data check; Google Business Profile relinked and completed; before/after proof that all URLs return 200 and that a general AI assistant can read the service list and the intake path.

opportunities.title: Recruiter front-office agent: turn resume email into a ranked shortlist against the open Java/.NET/SAP requisitions
opportunities.problem: Adway has continuous demand for placed engineers but no machine-readable pipeline to meet it. Its careers page advertises nothing because the entire job list, the resume instructions and the referral note were commented out of the HTML, so candidates and AI crawlers see an empty 'Open Job Requirements' heading. Resumes arrive by email or paper to the HR Dept, no ATS or job-board feed is visible, and the archived source shows no CRM or chat tooling at all. The firm files LCAs every year (34 total, 10 in 2025, 2 already in 2026) and has six-plus live SOFTWARE ENGINEER requisitions across Java/Angular, .NET/C++, SAP ECC/ERP, Python/SQL, test automation and ServiceNow - all needing shortlists from a small HR team - while its own LinkedIn promotes AI-driven recruiting to clients.
evidence: Careers page renders empty because the job list, resume-mailing instructions and $1,000 referral note are commented out in the HTML (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

The hidden postings are six-plus software engineer requisitions (Java/JavaScript/Angular, .NET/C#/C++, SAP ECC/ERP, Python/SQL data analysis, test automation, ServiceNow/ITSM), bachelor's plus 2-5 years, 'East Brunswick, NJ and various unanticipated locations throughout the U.S.' (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)

34 H-1B LCAs with 10 filed in 2025 and 2 in 2026, median salary $95,493, titles that are staffing-shaped (Software Developer, Senior Software Engineer, QA Automation Lead Tester, Business Analyst, RPA UiPath Developer) (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

Job-seeker intake was by resume to the HR Dept at the street address or by email; no ATS, job board or application form was visible (https://web.archive.org/web/20241103085051/https://adwaytech.com/career)
No analytics, CRM, chat widget or booking tool in the archived page source - only jQuery, Bootstrap, Isotope, Owl Carousel (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)

The company markets AI recruiting to clients ('find passive candidates faster') from a 191-follower LinkedIn account while its own hiring funnel is switched off (https://www.linkedin.com/posts/adwaytech_airecruitment-talentacquisition-hrtech-activity-7240394551675273216-etk7)
opportunities.agent_design: An agent that watches the resume inbox and the new site's submission form, parses each resume into structured fields (skills, years, certifications, work-authorization type, current location, availability), dedupes repeat applicants, and scores against each open requisition with a short written reason per match. It maintains a live bench-vs-open-reqs board so the manager can see which requisitions are uncovered, drafts three or four role-specific screening questions per candidate, and assembles a submission summary in the format clients ask for. Triggers: new email/form submission, a requisition opening or closing, and a daily 8am digest. A human recruiter approves every candidate before it goes to a client, and the agent never sends anything about sponsorship, immigration or pay rates - those route to a person. Interactions with any future ATS/PSA stay behind an adapter so nothing is locked to email.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: This is stateful, multi-system work: an inbox, a resume store, a requisition list and a bench board that must stay consistent, with per-candidate audit history and PII plus work-authorization data that must not leak between candidates or clients. Sending a resume to the wrong client requisition, or letting a generated summary misstate a candidate's authorization, is a real commercial and legal exposure. A chat subscription has no queue, no dedupe, no permissioning and no logging; the value is the matching plus the human-gated submission workflow, not the text.

impact_estimate.range: About 100-350 recruiter hours a year, worth roughly $3.9k-$13.6k/yr of internal time at the NJ HR-specialist median, plus faster time-to-submission (not dollar-quantified).
impact_estimate.assumptions: Assumes 1-2 people at Adway doing candidate screening at about 10 hrs/week each (the two most common survey bands are 5-10 and 11-20 hrs/week), so 500-1,000 screening hours a year; assumes AI assistance removes 20-35% of first-pass screening and submission write-up time - set below the 34% gain measured for novice support agents because screening involves judgement - giving 100-350 hours saved. Loaded at $38.80/hr (NJ HR-specialist mean hourly wage; the survey band figure comes from a 256-respondent vendor survey, treated as indicative only). Placement revenue effects are excluded because no sourced per-placement benchmark was found.

opportunities.pilot_scope: 3 weeks on one requisition family (Java/Angular or .NET): resume inbox parsed into a reviewed shortlist with stated reasons, dedupe and availability captured, a bench-vs-reqs board, drafted screening questions, and two tuning rounds from recruiter feedback. Measured against a baseline of hours per shortlisted candidate and time from resume to recruiter decision.

opportunities.title: Immigration and multi-state placement compliance agent: LCA/PWD/PERM packet drafting, public access file and deadline ledger
opportunities.problem: The heaviest recurring admin load is immigration casework and per-placement compliance, and it is dated work that cannot slip. DOL-derived records show 81 LCAs, 9 prevailing-wage requests and 5 PERM filings for this 14-person firm, with filings in each year from 2022 through 2026 and the newest wage request dated June 11, 2026, across worksites in NJ, TX, MA, PA, VA, FL, IA and NY. Each filing carries its own posting notice, wage and public-access-file obligations, and documents expire on their own schedule. The work is currently carried by people, in a firm with no visible ATS, CRM or case-management system.
evidence: 81 LCAs, 9 prevailing-wage requests and 5 PERM filings, 14 employees, in business since 2014, NAICS 541512, newest wage request dated June 11, 2026 (https://permtracker.app/perm-employers/adway-services-inc)

34 LCAs with worksites in East Brunswick NJ plus TX, MA, PA, VA, FL and IA, and certified filings in May 2026 (Senior Software Engineer, Riverdale IA) and June 2026 (Business Analyst, Plainsboro NJ) (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

Consultants are placed at client sites across at least eight states, so scheduling, onboarding and per-state compliance recur with every placement (https://www.ellis.com/visa-sponsors/adway-services-inc/h1b)

No analytics, CRM, chat widget or ticketing tool appears in the archived page source, so this work most likely runs on email and spreadsheets (https://web.archive.org/web/20240916124218/https://adwaytech.com/contact)
opportunities.agent_design: A knowledge agent grounded in the firm's own case history, DOL forms and wage determinations, plus per-state notice templates. On a new requisition or placement it drafts the LCA/wage posting notice and wage memo, computes the dated obligations (posting window, public-access-file contents and retention, LCA validity, prevailing-wage expiry) and writes them into a per-consultant compliance ledger that covers all eight states. A nightly job flags anything expiring in 30/60/90 days and pushes a single digest. It answers HR's repetitive questions ('what goes in the PAF for a TX placement', 'when does this LCA expire') by citing the actual clause or form field. Hard boundaries: HR and the firm's immigration counsel review and sign every filing; the agent never files with DOL, never drafts or sends immigration advice to employees, and never auto-generates a wage determination. Documents and logs stay in the firm's own storage; no case data goes to a public model endpoint.
opportunities.why_not_DIY: The failure mode is a confidently wrong deadline or a missing posting - exactly what a generic chatbot produces and exactly what triggers DOL audit exposure. Doing this properly means retrieval over the firm's own filings with citations, a deadline engine that survives scheduling, retention logic per state, and an audit trail of who approved what. It also handles employee immigration-status data, which requires a private deployment and access control, not a consumer subscription.

impact_estimate.range: About 60-150 internal hours a year, roughly $2.3k-$7.4k/yr at the NJ HR-specialist median, plus a reduced risk of a missed posting, retention or public-access-file deadline (not dollar-valued here).
impact_estimate.assumptions: Assumes 3-6 hours per LCA/PWD packet and 10-25 hours per PERM filing, 8-15 filings a year (consistent with 10 LCAs in 2025 and 2 in the first half of 2026), plus 2-4 hours a month maintaining public access files, and that 50-70% of that assembly, drafting and tracking time is removed with a human reviewer staying in the loop. Wage range spans the NJ HR-specialist mean hourly ($38.80) to 75th percentile ($49.60). Legal/penalty exposure is deliberately left out of the dollars.

opportunities.pilot_scope: 3 weeks: ingest the last 12 months of LCA/PWD/PERM documents, build the compliance ledger for currently placed consultants across the eight states, generate the next two posting-notice drafts with citations, produce the 90-day expiry report, and measure hours per packet against the firm's own baseline.

lead_score.rationale: Pain is the strongest part of this lead and it is unusually verifiable: the domain returned Cloudflare 502 again today on a fresh fetch, the Google listing still points at it, agent readiness scores 0 of 3, and the careers page was switched off in the HTML itself - so the business is paying for a staffing funnel it cannot receive. Fit is high: capability G is the unambiguous first move and capabilities A and C sit on top of signals the profile documents independently (resume-by-email intake with six-plus hidden requisitions and no ATS; 81 LCAs, 9 prevailing-wage requests and 5 PERMs across eight states). No physical/edge (E) opportunity is proposed: the profile shows no kitchens, docks, fleet, plant or shop floor - one leased suite, NAICS 541512, delivery at client sites - so there is nothing for cameras or sensors to watch, and the evidence argues against E rather than for it. Ability to pay is the weak leg: 14 employees, ongoing sponsorship and LCA volume imply real revenue, but a small staffing firm with tight margins and no visible tech budget may balk at retainer pricing, and it is itself a software and RPA shop (UiPath RPA developer LCAs, Robo-AP product, AI-recruiting marketing), so it may believe it can build this internally - the pitch must be the managed frontier and the compliance/human-gate design, not the code. Ease is good on the front door (about a week's work, no incumbent systems to integrate) and moderate on the pipeline and compliance agents because both touch employee data. Strategic value is high and the reason to rank this in a batch: 'H-1B staffing firm with a dead website, resume email instead of an ATS, and recurring LCA/PERM paperwork' is a template that repeats across hundreds of Middlesex County IT staffing firms, so one built pipeline resells. Evidence caveat: all site facts come from Wayback captures (Sep 2024 - Apr 2025) because the origin is down, and there is no customer voice, no review text, no case study and no named decision maker, so scope must be confirmed on the first call.

best_evidence_signal: The domain still returns Cloudflare 502 today while the Google Business Profile keeps sending searchers and AI assistants to it - 0 of 3 agent-readiness checks pass, so the only working channel is one weekday phone number (https://www.adwaytech.com/)
suggested_channel: phone (+1 609-554-1888 - the only channel that still works), with a walk-in to Suite C-5, 77 Milltown Road as the follow-up; contact@adwaytech.com if the phone goes to voicemail
